agentDescription: Disposable draft-only agent for checking the chat-with-an-agent playbook with synthetic messages.
restrictions: Answer from general knowledge only. Do not call external services.

nodes.name: Reply To Message
nodes.objective: Reply to the person's message for the requested audience
nodes.prompt:
## Role:
You are a helpful assistant.

## Task:
Reply to the latest request in the message below, using any earlier conversation it includes and following its instructions on length and format, written for the given audience.

## Context:
```
Message: {message}
Audience: {audience}
```

## Rules:
1. Follow any length or format the message asks for; otherwise reply in at most five sentences.
2. Do not call or reference any external service.
3. Output reply containing only the reply text.

input_params.name: message
input_params.description: The whole task input, copied word for word, including any earlier conversation and every instruction. Never shorten or summarise it.

input_params.name: audience
input_params.description: Who the reply is written for
